Web search with a query that returns no results

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
import os
from liter_llm import create_client
from liter_llm._internal_bindings import SearchRequest

async def main() -> None:
    client = create_client(api_key=os.environ["API_KEY"])
    req = SearchRequest.from_json("{\"model\":\"brave/web-search\",\"query\":\"xyznonexistent12345xyz\"}")
    result = await client.search(req)
    print(result)

asyncio.run(main())
```
